next_step: Run 100M-document performance POC in customer's EU VPC; deliver cost/latency model and security attestation
blockers: p95 latency for cross-encoder reranker under 200 qps
notes:
Background: LodeFinder builds enterprise e-discovery/search for regulated counsel and corporate compliance teams. Initial hosted PoC tested embeddings + simple rerank; now moving to private/VPC for data residency and audit controls. -- Index size: ~120M documents (~2TB raw, avg 4k tokens/doc). Want high recall + legal-grade audit logging. Team quote: "We need legal defensibility: immutable audit trails, retention policy enforcement, and KMS for keys."

Technical reqs (from architecture call):
- Primary flow: bi-encoder ANN to retrieve top-200, then cross-encoder rerank top-50 for final results.
- Embedding dim target: 1536 (or equivalent), quantized storage supported.
- Indexing scale: 100M+ vectors; expect ~10% growth/yr. Need compact index storage + incremental updates.
- Latency SLO: single-query P50 < 200ms end-to-end (retrieve+rerank), P95 < 800ms for legal review UX.
- Throughput target: baseline 150 qps, burst up to 300 qps during e-discovery runs.
- Cost sensitivity: target < $0.05/query (amortized across retrieval+rerank); care about tokenized reranker cost per re-rank.
- Accuracy targets: recall@200 >= 0.95 for known-relevant sets; reranker improves top-10 precision by >= 20% vs bi-encoder only.
- Storage/residency: EU-only; customer-managed KMS/HSM; retention controls for query logs (7 years), with redaction API for PII.
- Compliance: SOC2 + ISO27001 required; expect Redwood attestation and right-to-audit clauses.

Procurement/Legal: LodeFinder requires vendor DPA + security annex, liability caps to be negotiated. Legal wants explicit data flow diagrams and proof that query logs can be exported and then purged per retention policy.

POC plan agreed: host 25M subset in Redwood private VPC (EU region) for performance tuning (vector config, HNSW vs IVF+PQ, PQ bits). If baseline metrics met, expand to 100M for scale run and run canary queries from live UI. SE (Arjun) to run architecture workshop next week.

Sales notes / quick hits:
- They like Redwood's unified serving model and routing/fallback ideas (canary to cheaper quantized model).
- Key ask: benchmark with cross-encoder running on dedciated GPU pool (pinned) to meet p95 SLO.
- Show cost model: tokens for reranker + GPU-hours for cross-encoder + retrieval infra (index maintenance).

Customer sentiment: engaged but conservative. Security/DPO is the gating factor. Procurement timeline 6-8 weeks after security sign-off.
